title: REA patch manifest
description: Machine-readable record of the changes applied to a binary.

target.description: Path of the file the manifest was written for.

target_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the unmodified target. The applier refuses a mismatch.

architecture.description: x86, x86-64, arm, arm64, arm64e, or a comma-separated list for universal artefacts.

notes.description: Free-form note describing the change and its justification.

id.description: Short stable identifier for the patch.

reason.description: What the patch changes and why.

match.description: Hex byte string expected at the offset, e.g. '0f 85 7b 00 00 00'.

replace.description: Hex byte string written in place of the match. Same length as the match.

offset.description: File offset of the first byte.

virtual_address.description: Virtual address of the first byte, for readability.

section.description: Section containing the offset, when known.
